entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed. I bought this ClubFit jersey a while back, and I feel terrible about this.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I guess. It's the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a ride yesterday, and it's just way too tight across the chest. I can barely zip it up.
Okay, so a sizing issue. I understand that can be frustrating. Do you happen to know when you received the item?

Oh, it was a while ago... maybe a little over two months? I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited for it. I was really hoping I could do an exchange or something. I really needed this money for some bills this month.
I completely understand. Let me just pull up our official return policy here. One moment, please.
Alright, I've got it. According to our policy, for standard items like that jersey, we have a 90-day return window. Since you received it about 75 days ago, you're still within that period.
Wait, really? So I can still return it? I was so worried I had waited too long.
Yes, absolutely. You're well within the timeframe. We can definitely process a full refund for you. I can email you a prepaid return label right now.
Oh, that's fantastic! Thank you so much, Charlie. You have no idea what a relief that is. I really appreciate your help.
Of course, I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that was it. You've been a great help. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
